description: Get recent trigger activity for the user's price alerts — which alerts have fired, how many times, and when they last triggered. Use when the user asks whether any alerts have gone off or about recent alert activity. REQUIRES an API key (OILPRICEAPI_KEY). Note: the API tracks trigger history as per-alert counters (trigger_count / last_triggered_at) rather than a separate event feed, so this returns alerts that have triggered.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 date/time (e.g., '2026-06-01' or '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'). Only alerts last triggered on or after this time are shown.

name: opa_get_alert_triggers
title: Get Alert Triggers
